name: dsh-message-recall
description: Message recall for DeepSeek Harness: a recall button on every user bubble that hides the message and everything after it, truncates the model context, and puts the original text back into the composer. Works in the Web GUI and the desktop client (one shared client bundle).
author: User-Clb

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check src/recall.js && node --check client.cjs
